main_text.p: ad 14. Tertia pars demonstrationem complectitur diuinitatis Christi, & indurata pertinacia Pharisæorum: vsque ad v. 38. Quarta hypocrisin detegit signum petentium, cum graui comminatione poenarum, v. 38. Vltima Doctrinam habet, quo loco amici carnales habendi sint in causa religionis, à v. 46. vsque ad finem cap.

Cap. xiii. recitantur septem parabolæ quas Christus de natura & conditione Euangelij atque Ecclesiæ apud turbam proposuit, & nonnullas earum discipulis suis priuatim explicauit: exponit etiam causas cur hoc dicendi genere sit vsus. In fine addit historiam de scandalo Nazarethanorum, quod acceperunt ex doctrina & miraculis Christi.

Cap. xiiii. Fama Christi doctrinam cœlestem stupendis miraculis confirmantis in aulam Herodis peruenit, & ipsum Herodem excitat in eius admirationem: quare de Christo nō obscurē suum fert iudicium, hac occasione 1. prolixior texitur narratio de Iohanne Baptista occiso à Nerone. 1 1. Redit ad θαυμασιουργίαν[?] Christi, cuius tria miracula commemorantur. 1 Cibatio quinquies mille & amplius hominum é quinque panibus. v. 13. 2 de ambulatione Christi & Petri super mare, v. 22. 3 sanatio ægrotorum in terra Genezareth. v. 34.

Cap. xv. narrantur quatuor. 1 Disceptatio Christi cum scribis & pharisæis Hierosolymitanis, vsque ad v. 21. Deinde sanatio puellæ dæmoniacæ Chananææ, vsque ad v.29. Tertiò sanatio multorum ac variorum ægrotorum, vsque ad v.32. Postremò cibatio quater mille virorum per septem panes vsque ad finem capitis.

page.notes: Printed page 43, running head "SECVNDVM MATHAEVM." No catchword or signature. Left-edge strip shows the neighbouring page's margin fragments, not transcribed. Long s rendered as plain s. "complectitur" is set with a ligature that is hard to read; the reading is likely but not certain. The Greek word "θαυμασιουργίαν" is partly unclear at its first letters and is marked [?]. Italic runs were judged from the scan and may not be exact.
